name: blockchain-supply-chain
description: Full-Stack Blockchain Supply Chain Management System with Node.js/Express backend & React frontend

scripts.start:dev: concurrently "npm run chain" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install --production=false && npm run build
scripts.render-build: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install --production=false && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install --production=false && npm run build
